snippet.title: Official Horror Gameplay Reveal | MINDFLUX: Dead Man Walking
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/29...

We're going 1st person and horror in this new narrative experience inspired by old school RPGs. 

You are a cybernetic detective on the brink of madness. The only doctor who can save you is missing. Modify your brain to extract clues, bargain with ghosts from your past at the cost of sanity, and survive a decaying world of nightmares in this first-person horror RPG. 

Website: https://lostgatestudios.com
Twitter: https://x.com/LostGateStudios
LinkedIn:   https://www.linkedin.com/company/lost-gate-studios 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lostgatestudios/ 
 Pinterest: https://www.pinterest.com/LostGateStudios/ 

CREDITS

Editing: Chandler Bastin
Sound Design: Ishaan Singh, Chandler Bastin
Thumbnail: Andrew Lowry
Gameplay Footage & Animation: Lost Gate Studios Dev Team
